Framing: keep the same composition and horizon as motion passes through the frame. End: finish from the same camera angle with visible passage of time.

items.name: Pass-through objects
items.displayed_prompt: pass-through movement. Movement: move forward toward a visible object, surface or barrier and continue into the space beyond. Speed: smooth centered glide. Framing: keep the opening or surface centered as the transition point. End: arrive inside the revealed space beyond.
